label: agent channels • n8n webhook ingress: verify-before-parse, fail-closed allowlists, dedupe, poll ownership
query: deterministic policy pin — no model involved
notes: n8n inbound contract over the REAL AgentChannelWebhookIngress with an in-memory store, a fixed secret resolver and a recording relay. Pins: a bad secret with an unparseable body is 401 before any parsing or storage; a verified, allowlisted envelope is 202 with task_id == session partition id and a poll_url; a replayed event_id is 200 duplicate with the same task_id and no second dispatch; unknown sender / conversation are 202 rejected with sender_not_allowlisted / room_not_allowlisted and no dispatch or rows; v:2 is 400 unsupported_envelope_version and a missing content is 400 invalid_payload; non-loopback plaintext is 426 secure_channel_required unless the call rides Secure Channel or the connection allows plaintext; polling an owned task returns sanitized output while foreign/unknown tasks are 404; the secret never appears in any response, activity event or audit row. CI-safe: no network, no model, no keychain.
